Syntax:
ara::core::Optional<std::uint8_t> f;
Description:
std::uint8_t optional member variable which represents the IEEE1722 defined f (field) 1 bit
header field of an IEEE1722 stream with subtype RVF.
The value range for f shall be:
0x00...0x01 : valid
0x02...0xFF : not used
For transmission, the value of f shall be set to the configured value, if it is not provided by the
application.
